parameters.name: startDate
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const now = new Date(); const day = now.getDay(); const diff = day === 0 ? 7 : day; const end = new Date(now.getTime() - diff * 86400000); const start = new Date(end.getTime() - 6 * 86400000); return start.toISOString().slice(0, 10); })() }}

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.value: ={{ (() => { const now = new Date(); const day = now.getDay(); const diff = day === 0 ? 7 : day; const end = new Date(now.getTime() - diff * 86400000); return end.toISOString().slice(0, 10); })() }}
